articles.title: Tesla, SpaceX Take a Hit as Dems' Sweep Midterms; McDonald's Moves on Revenue | Stock Movers
articles.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX) are lower this morning as Elon Musk's companies take a hit after a Democratic sweep in the Midterm elections and the prospect for tighter regulations. - McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving after the fast food chain reported higher profit and revenue in the latest quarter, with solid performance across much of its international business offsetting sluggish sales in the U.S. - Uber (UBER) shares are following news the company posted weaker-than-expected ride-hail bookings due to driver supply constraints overseas and ongoing tensions in the Middle East.
